revisions.source:
FOX News can now project Biden is the apparent winner in Wyoming

You’ve done it. After years and years of fighting, you’ve done it. You’ve singlehanded brought an end to Malarkey. Trump contests the results, but no one takes him seriously. Republican Governors don’t even think about overturning the results as they fear your sheer political clout. Day One, you’ll be signing the 'No Malarkey! Act', which will remove what few Republicans remain. Sit back and relax, with your ice cream and aviator shades, because you’ve become the most powerful man ever.
revisions.zh:
福克斯新闻现在预测：拜登有望赢得怀俄明州

你做到了。经过这么多年的奋斗，你终于做到了。你凭一己之力终结了所有胡扯。特朗普质疑选举结果，但没人把他当回事。共和党州长甚至不敢考虑推翻结果——你的政治威势令他们胆寒。上任第一天，你就要签署《别来虚的！法案》，清除仅剩的那几个共和党人。吃着冰淇淋，戴着飞行员墨镜，安心享受吧：你已经成为史上最有权势的人。

revisions.source:
Amogus

You appear to have undershot by
revisions.zh:
阿莫格斯

你似乎还差

revisions.source: We are going to - wait. Did you really get THAT many electoral votes? Good job... I guess? I must say though, for all of your complaints of Democratic fraud, your margin here really is a bit sus. Regardless, Congress is safely in Republican hands, and if you aren't impeached for electoral fraud then you can certainly pass your agenda. You will be able to make America great again... maybe.
revisions.zh: 我们要——等等。你真拿到了那么多选举人票？干得好……大概吧？不过，你整天抱怨民主党舞弊，自己这次的胜差却也有点可疑。无论如何，共和党稳稳掌握着国会；只要你没有因选举舞弊遭到弹劾，就能推进自己的议程。你将能够让美国再次伟大……也许吧。

revisions.source: Cope liberals! Trump wins again! Massive wins! Supermajorities in both houses! Trump became a [Big Shot]!!!11!!!!!!
revisions.zh: 自由派，破防去吧！特朗普又赢了！大获全胜！两院都拿下了压倒性多数！特朗普成了[大人物]！！！11！！！！！！

revisions.source: Read my lips. There will be no new anti-gun legislation when I am President.
revisions.zh: 听清楚了。我当总统期间，绝不会出台新的反枪支立法。

revisions.source: Read my lips. There will be no new taxes under my Administration.
revisions.zh: 听清楚了。在我执政期间，绝不增加新税。

revisions.source:
“GOD FUCKING DAMNIT GORE”

Those words rang out from the president's office, despite the door being shut. In the room, were President Bill Clinton and Vice President Al Gore.'I BROUGHT THE ECONOMY BACK FROM A TERRIBLE STATE RUN BY INCOMPETENT REPUBLICANS. I WON DURING THE MID-TERMS AND GAVE YOU A FREE TICKET TO THE PRESIDENCY. AND WHAT DO YOU DO? YOU LET THE SON OF THE GUY WHO I BEAT BECOME PRESIDENT! 538 VOTES TO 0!' Those were the words of a less than happy Bill Clinton. Gore responded 'I-I don't know what happened, I-I thought I ran a good campaign b-but...' Clinton interrupted, saying 'You know exactly what happened Gore. For some reason, you did a tank photo op like Dukakis, which is already bad enough. BUT THEN you accidentally fired the tank, I have no clue how, those things are hard to fire, and you hit a group of spectators. Killing 5. Your court date is in a month so you better start prepping a defence team.' 'co-' 'If you’re asking me for a pardon, you can shove it. Then in your speech to the nation about it, you claimed the ghost of William Mckinley had fired the tank by controlling your body. You then spent 50 thousand dollars of taxpayer money on hiring an exorcist to try and remove him. That’s why you lost, Al.
revisions.zh:
“戈尔，你他妈的搞什么！”

总统办公室的门关着，吼声却还是传了出来。屋里是比尔·克林顿总统和阿尔·戈尔副总统。“我把被无能共和党人搞得一塌糊涂的经济救了回来。我赢了中期选举，把总统宝座拱手送到你面前。可你干了什么？你居然让那个被我打败的家伙的儿子当上总统！538票对0票！”克林顿显然气坏了。戈尔回答：“我、我不知道怎么回事，我、我以为我的竞选搞得挺好，可、可是……”克林顿打断了他：“你很清楚怎么回事，戈尔。你不知抽了什么风，学杜卡基斯坐坦克拍宣传照，光这就够糟了。可你随后居然误开了炮——我都不知道你怎么办到的，那玩意儿可没那么容易开火——击中了一群观众，死了五个人。一个月后你就要出庭，最好赶紧找个辩护团队。”“克——”“要是想求我赦免你，免谈。然后你向全国解释这件事时，居然说麦金莱的鬼魂控制了你的身体，替你开的炮。你还花了五万美元纳税人的钱，请驱魔师把他赶走。阿尔，这就是你输掉的原因。

revisions.source: “TANK YOU VERY MUCH”
We need to change the imagery on this issue. Let's do a photo-op of me riding in a tank.
revisions.zh: 我们得改变公众在这个问题上对我的印象。安排我乘坐坦克拍一组宣传照吧。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, this move backfired. You just don't look all that imposing when you're riding in a tank. Republicans are producing television commercials with the picture.
revisions.zh: 可惜，这招适得其反。你坐在坦克里，看起来实在没什么威风。共和党人正拿这张照片制作电视广告。

revisions.source: To what extent will your campaign attack the Massachusetts prison furlough program, and/or the murder committed by Willie Horton?
revisions.zh: 你的竞选团队打算在多大程度上攻击马萨诸塞州的离监休假制度，以及威利·霍顿犯下的谋杀案？

revisions.source: We will attack the prison furlough system in general, perhaps with a “revolving door” ad or something of that nature. And the Willie Horton episode is certainly an egregious example of the practice.
revisions.zh: 我们要从整体上攻击离监休假制度，比如拍一则“旋转门”广告。霍顿事件当然就是这个制度最恶劣的例子。

revisions.source: The Bush campaign is attacking the Massachusetts prison furlough program, which included furloughs for convicted murderers. One such person, Willie Horton, killed again in Maryland. What is your response?
revisions.zh: 布什阵营正在攻击马萨诸塞州的离监休假制度，连已定罪的杀人犯也能获准离监。其中一人威利·霍顿在马里兰州再次杀人。你将如何回应？

revisions.source: Your running mate, Lloyd Bentsen, is widely believed to have defeated Dan Quayle in the Vice Presidential debate. Will you come back to this moment in your TV ads or speeches?
revisions.zh: 普遍认为，你的竞选搭档劳埃德·本特森在副总统辩论中击败了丹·奎尔。你会在电视广告或演说中再次提起这场交锋吗？

revisions.source: In your acceptance speech at the 1964 Republican National Convention, you said 'And may I remind you that extremism in the defense of liberty is no vice.' What did you mean by that?
revisions.zh: 在1964年共和党全国代表大会接受提名的演说中，你说：“我要提醒大家，为捍卫自由而采取极端立场，并非恶行。”你这句话是什么意思？

revisions.source: It's no surprise to anyone that you’re dragging muck into the race, but the ads your staff come up with are extremely effective- including such classics as the “Daisy” ad, among others.
revisions.zh: 你在竞选中抹黑对手，谁也不会感到意外；但幕僚制作的广告确实极其有效，其中就包括“雏菊”等后来成为经典的广告。

revisions.source: Lyndon Johnson has aired an ad depicting a little girl picking flowers, followed by the sound of a nuclear countdown. This ad, known as the ‘Daisy’ ad, is causing much trouble for the Goldwater campaign.
revisions.zh: 林登·约翰逊播出了一则广告：小女孩正在摘花，随后响起核爆倒计时。这则被称为“雏菊”的广告，给戈德华特阵营带来了很大麻烦。

revisions.source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1968 election!

In one of the great turnarounds of American politics, you have salvaged your once-wrecked political career and shed your label as a 'loser' once and for all. As it turns out, the press will have Nixon to kick around.

If you can end the War in Vietnam and roll back the excesses of the Great Society, you may just go down as a truly great President. Good luck working with a Democratic Congress, however...
revisions.zh:
恭喜！你赢得了1968年大选！

这是美国政治史上一次惊人的东山再起：你挽救了曾经破败的政治生涯，终于甩掉了“失败者”的标签。看来，媒体还是会有尼克松供他们攻击和奚落。

如果你能结束越南战争，收缩“伟大社会”政策的过度扩张，你或许能成为一位真正伟大的总统。不过，面对民主党掌控的国会，祝你好运……

revisions.source: After your second loss in a presidential election, your chances of being renominated for the presidency, or ANYTHING for that matter is nearly zero. Retirement and an elder statesman position are all that will await you. It seems Americans will once and for all not have Nixon to kick around…
revisions.zh: 第二次输掉总统选举后，你再次获得总统提名的机会几乎归零；说到底，再获任何职位提名都希望渺茫。等待你的只有退休，以及政治元老的身份。看来，美国人这次真的再也没有尼克松可供他们攻击和奚落了……

revisions.source: The murders and rioting in America will be your first order of business, and more long term, the war on Vietnam. If both of those are dealt with, your silent majority will be pleased. Other than that, inflation must be dealt with, as well as the excess of Great Society. Good luck, and welcome back to the executive branch!
revisions.zh: 美国的凶杀与骚乱是你上任后首先要处理的问题；从更长远看，还有越南战争。如果两者都能解决，你的“沉默的大多数”就会满意。此外，你还得应对通货膨胀，以及“伟大社会”政策的过度扩张。祝你好运，欢迎重返行政部门！

revisions.source:
Hubert H. Humphrey, the senior Senator from Minnesota, is a divisive figure in the Democratic Party- loved and loathed by integrationists and segregationists, respectively, Humphrey is well known as the Democrat’s “happy warrior”. He first rose to prominence in 1948 with his successful lobbying for a civil rights plank in Harry Truman’s campaign, and has maintained a consistently progressive, integrationist record in the Senate ever since

Humphrey will balance the ticket with Johnson, and his ties to unions will boost the campaign in the Midwest, as will his liberal stances in the Northeast. However, he expects Johnson to strongly support civil rights, and his reputation will only serve to push the segregationist wing of the party further away.
revisions.zh:
明尼苏达州资深参议员休伯特·H.·汉弗莱，在民主党内是个颇具争议的人物：支持种族融合者爱戴他，支持种族隔离者则厌恶他。他以民主党的“快乐斗士”闻名。1948年，他成功推动哈里·杜鲁门的竞选纲领加入民权条款，由此崭露头角。此后，他在参议院始终坚持进步主义与种族融合立场。

汉弗莱能与约翰逊形成搭配。他与工会的联系有利于中西部竞选，他的自由派立场也能在东北部争取支持。不过，他期待约翰逊坚定支持民权，而他的名声只会进一步疏远党内的种族隔离派。

revisions.source: The happy warrior rises! Despite a climate of chaos and a split in the Democratic Party, you've beaten back the opposition and secured a third term for the Democrats. Johnson breathes a sigh of relief after this, and poor Nixon is once again a loser. To the shock of pundits countrywide, you beat Nixon and Wallace handily. The bombing halt and your inspiring words compared to Nixon must have won it for you.
revisions.zh: 快乐斗士奋起了！尽管全国混乱、民主党四分五裂，你仍击退对手，为民主党赢得连续第三届总统任期。约翰逊终于松了口气，可怜的尼克松又成了输家。全国评论家都大吃一惊：你轻松击败了尼克松和华莱士。停止轰炸，加上你比尼克松更鼓舞人心的演说，想必就是制胜之因。

revisions.source: The happy warrior rises! Despite a climate of chaos and a split in the Democratic Party, you've beaten back the opposition and secured a third term for the Democrats. Johnson breathes a sigh of relief after this, and poor Nixon is once again a loser. It seems America is ready to give the New Deal Democrats one last chance. If you succeed, you might be able to rebuild the coalition that's won them so many elections (well, not the Deep South, but you knew that).
revisions.zh: 快乐斗士奋起了！尽管全国混乱、民主党四分五裂，你仍击退对手，为民主党赢得连续第三届总统任期。约翰逊终于松了口气，可怜的尼克松又成了输家。看来，美国准备再给新政民主党人最后一次机会。倘若成功，你或许能重建那个为他们赢得过无数选举的联盟——当然，深南部除外，这你早就知道。

revisions.source: The happy warrior rises! Despite a climate of chaos and a split in the Democratic Party, you've beaten back the opposition and secured a third term for the Democrats. Johnson breathes a sigh of relief after this, and poor Nixon is once again a loser. He did quite well, however, so you best work hard, lest the midterms act mercilessly.
revisions.zh: 快乐斗士奋起了！尽管全国混乱、民主党四分五裂，你仍击退对手，为民主党赢得连续第三届总统任期。约翰逊终于松了口气，可怜的尼克松又成了输家。不过，他的表现相当不错；你最好努力执政，否则中期选举可不会手下留情。

revisions.source: The Happy Warrior, our choice!
revisions.zh: 快乐斗士，就是我们的选择！

revisions.source:
Hubert Humphrey's inauguration address, January 20th, 1969.

Today I have stood, where once Abraham Lincoln stood and took an oath to my country. It is very appropriate then that from this bastion of America, this very heart of the great men who created the principles of freedom in this country, that today we sound the drum for freedom as have our generations of forebears before us done, time and time again through history. Let us rise to the call of freedom-loving blood that is in us and send our answer to the tyranny that clanks its chains upon the Negro. In the name of the greatest country that has ever trod this earth, I draw the line in the dust and toss the gauntlet before the feet of tyranny . . . and I say . . . desegregation today . . . desegregation tomorrow . . . desegregation forever!
revisions.zh:
休伯特·汉弗莱的就职演说，1969年1月20日。

今天，我站在亚伯拉罕·林肯曾经站过的地方，向我的国家庄严宣誓。因此，从这座美国的堡垒，从那些为这个国家奠定自由原则的伟人精神所系之地，再次擂响自由的战鼓，正是理所应当——正如我们的先辈一代又一代，在历史上无数次做过的那样。让我们响应血液中热爱自由的召唤，向那把锁链铐在黑人身上的暴政作出回答。以这个世界上最伟大的国家之名，我在尘土中划下界线，把挑战的铁手套掷到暴政脚下……我要说……今天废除种族隔离……明天废除种族隔离……永远废除种族隔离！

revisions.source: A number of campaign reforms, many to do with finance will likely be enacted in light of Watergate, as the scandal preceding the Checkers speech Nixon gave in 52 is fresh in the minds of many. Other than that, Inflation and the USSR are yours to deal with, although the former will likely be dealt with differently than the past Democratic, New Deal administrations. If you stay true and honest to America and help fix those problems, poor Reagan won't know what's waiting for him in 80.
revisions.zh: 鉴于水门事件，而尼克松1952年“切克斯演说”之前的那场丑闻也仍让许多人记忆犹新，一系列竞选改革很可能出台，其中不少涉及资金问题。此外，通货膨胀和苏联也是你必须应对的挑战；不过，处理通胀的方式，很可能与过去推行新政的民主党政府不同。只要你对美国保持真诚、诚实，并协助解决这些问题，可怜的里根到了1980年就不知道自己会碰上什么了。

revisions.source: The Democratic Convention erupted into spontaneous cries of “He kept us out of war!” as you were nominated. Do you plan to campaign on this position, or will you add some nuance to it?
revisions.zh: 你获得提名时，民主党大会上的代表自发高呼：“他让我们免于战争！”你打算以此为竞选主张，还是给这个说法加上更审慎的说明？

revisions.source:
William Jennings Bryan electrified the convention in Chicago with his famous "Cross of Gold" speech.

Running as a liberal and an evangelical, his primary issue is the inflation of the currency through the free coinage of silver. This gives him fanatical support amongst the farmers of the South and the West. Lacking the funds to run a large campaign, Bryan will bring his speaking talents to bear by touring the United States.
revisions.zh:
威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩凭借著名的“黄金十字架”演说，震撼了芝加哥的党代会。

他以自由派和福音派基督徒的身份参选，核心主张是通过自由铸银扩大货币供应、推动物价上涨。这为他赢得了南方和西部农民的狂热支持。由于缺乏开展大规模竞选的资金，布赖恩将周游美国，发挥自己的演说才能。

revisions.source: You will be making another speech today from the front porch of your home in Canton, Ohio. What will you discuss?
revisions.zh: 今天，你将在俄亥俄州坎顿的家中，再次从前廊向来访者发表演说。你打算谈些什么？

revisions.source: This episode shows that Mr. Clay is, at heart, an insider who is overly favorable to Northern politicians. It brings to mind the Corrupt Bargain of a prior election.
revisions.zh: 这件事说明，克莱先生骨子里就是个过分偏袒北方政客的政坛圈内人。这让人想起了早先那次选举中的“腐败交易”。

revisions.source: Was there really a bargain (a “Corrupt Bargain” to many) between yourself and John Quincy Adams which elevated him to the Presidency in 1825?
revisions.zh: 你与约翰·昆西·亚当斯之间，是否真的达成了一项让他在1825年当上总统的交易——也就是许多人所说的“腐败交易”？

revisions.source: We need to be just as aggressive on this issue as we are anywhere else. “Fifty-four Forty or Fight!”
revisions.zh: 在这个问题上，我们也要像在其他问题上一样强硬。“北纬54度40分，否则开战！”

revisions.source: Should the Social Security Trust Fund be purchasing U.S. Treasury bills? Should it be allowed to invest in other bonds and securities to potentially increase its rate of return? Or conversely, should the funds be held in a 'lockbox' to guarantee benefit payments?
revisions.zh: 社会保障信托基金应当购买美国短期国债吗？是否应允许它投资其他债券和证券，以争取更高回报？还是应当把资金锁进“保险箱”，确保福利金能够支付？

revisions.source: I would establish an iron-clad lockbox for the Social Security fund. When we allow the federal government to borrow our Social Security money, we put every senior in this country at risk.
revisions.zh: 我要为社会保障基金设立一个牢不可破的“保险箱”。允许联邦政府借用我们的社保资金，就会让全国每一位老年人都面临风险。

revisions.source: Hillary has been forced to take on a lighter campaign schedule, at the same time that her "basket of deplorables" comment is going viral. Not a bad series of events for you...
revisions.zh: 希拉里被迫减少竞选活动，与此同时，她说的那句“一帮可鄙之人”正在广泛传播。这一连串事情对你倒是很有利……

revisions.source: During a fundraiser, you made a comment that around half of Trump's supporters form a "basket of deplorables", with a renewed emphasis on racism, bigotry, and Islamophobia. Do you care to clarify?
revisions.zh: 在一次筹款活动中，你说大约一半的特朗普支持者是“一帮可鄙之人”，再次强调了种族主义、偏执与反穆斯林情绪。你打算作进一步澄清吗？

revisions.source:
Fear and Loathing in Trump Hotel

What?! You lost?! By 1 electoral vote? Rage fills your body as the results come in. Your vision begins to go red. Those crooked Dems cheated you! They rigged it just enough that you lose, so they could taunt you. Donald Trump does not get cheated. You built an empire with just a small loan of a million dollars. You became President despite every pundit and pollster. No no no, Donald Trump does not lose. You're going to PERSONALLY do the recount in
revisions.zh:
特朗普酒店里的恐惧与厌恶

什么？！你输了？！就差一张选举人票？结果传来，你怒火中烧，眼前渐渐一片血红。那些狡诈的民主党人骗了你！他们把结果操纵得刚好让你落败，好拿你取乐。唐纳德·特朗普绝不会任人欺骗。只凭一百万美元的“小额贷款”，你就建立了一个商业帝国。尽管评论家和民调机构都不看好，你还是当上了总统。不，不，不，唐纳德·特朗普不会输。你要亲自去重新计票，地点是

revisions.source: The crooked media is in the tank for Joe Biden and his son Hunter, and they are doing everything they can to make my term, one of the most successful ever, look like a disaster. Don't fall for it!
revisions.zh: 这些无耻的媒体一边倒地袒护乔·拜登和他的儿子亨特，千方百计把我这个史上最成功的任期之一说成一场灾难。别上他们的当！

revisions.source: I don't know what's really going on here, but can you imagine how the media would be covering it if this was Donald Jr.? Can there be any more doubt they are in the tank for Sleepy Joe?
revisions.zh: 我不知道这里到底是怎么回事，但你们想想，假如换成小唐纳德，媒体会怎么报道？他们一边倒地袒护瞌睡乔，这还有什么可怀疑的吗？

revisions.source: Anyone who knows me should know the answer to this question. I support the free coinage of silver at a price ratio of 16-to-1 versus gold.
revisions.zh: 了解我的人都该知道答案。我支持按白银与黄金16比1的法定比价实行自由铸银。

revisions.source: Trade is a bit of a hot potato issue within your party, and it's definitely a bit risky in this election to come out stringly on either side.
revisions.zh: 贸易是你们党内的一个棘手议题。在这次选举中，无论坚决站在哪一边，都有一定风险。

revisions.source: Thousands of young men have formed paramilitary “Wide Awake” clubs and marched to support Republicans. Should your party embrace this support, or is it too divisive?
revisions.zh: 成千上万的年轻人组成了准军事化的“觉醒者”社团，列队游行支持共和党。你们党应当接纳这股支持力量，还是认为它过于容易激化分歧？

revisions.source: Do you have any comment on the paramilitary “Wide Awake” clubs that have marched in support of Republicans?
revisions.zh: 对于那些列队游行支持共和党的准军事化“觉醒者”社团，你有什么评论？

revisions.source: Every party has political clubs and supporters. There's no reason to take special alarm at the Wide Awakes.
revisions.zh: 每个政党都有自己的政治社团和支持者。没理由对“觉醒者”格外惊慌。

revisions.source: The 1948 election begins with President Truman trailing badly in the polls. Thomas Dewey, loser in 1944, is widely expected to redeem himself this time around. Truman not only has to deal with Dewey, a moderate Republican, but also with two splinter candidates. Henry Wallace is a far-left candidate with the Progressive Party, while Strom Thurmond runs as a Dixiecrat. Some hot issues are the Soviet Union, civil rights, the "Do-Nothing" Congress, and the Taft-Hartley Act.
revisions.zh: 1948年大选开始时，杜鲁门总统在民调中大幅落后。1944年败选的托马斯·杜威，被普遍看好能在这次选举中挽回颜面。杜鲁门不但要应对这位温和派共和党人，还要面对两名从原有阵营分裂出去的候选人：亨利·华莱士代表进步党，以极左立场参选；斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德则以迪克西民主党人的身份竞选。苏联、民权、“无所作为的国会”和《塔夫脱—哈特利法案》，都是此次选举的热点议题。

revisions.source: What Truman really means when he calls this the "Do-Nothing" Congress is that they won't pass a program for national health insurance or the drastic expansion of Social Security. I will attack Truman for calling a pointless session for his own political purposes.
revisions.zh: 杜鲁门所谓“无所作为的国会”，其实是说他们不肯通过全国医疗保险计划，也不肯大幅扩张社会保障制度。我要抨击他为了自己的政治目的，召开毫无意义的特别会议。

revisions.source: Your Democratic counterpart has repeatedly challenged you to a debate. After your debacle against Kennedy in 1960, will you debate your opponent this time?
revisions.zh: 民主党的对手一再向你发出辩论邀请。1960年与肯尼迪辩论时你惨遭失败，这次还会与对手辩论吗？

revisions.source: There has been a proposal for a series of television debates between you and Kennedy. Is this something you are interested in?
revisions.zh: 有人提议安排你与肯尼迪举行一系列电视辩论。你对此有兴趣吗？

revisions.source:
Sorry! You have lost the 2012 election.

In spite of your spirited defense, Mitt Romney has won the Presidency. Nearly two centuries after the ill-fated campaign of Joseph Smith, Romney will become America's first Mormon president.

On the political front, it appears that Romney will make a push for more tax cuts to revive the economy. He will also try to repeal your health care law. If your defeat was narrow enough, you may be able to attempt a comeback in 2016.
revisions.zh:
很遗憾！你输掉了2012年大选。

尽管你奋力捍卫自己的执政记录，米特·罗姆尼还是赢得了总统职位。距离约瑟夫·斯密那场命运多舛的竞选近两个世纪之后，罗姆尼将成为美国首位摩门教徒总统。

在政策方面，罗姆尼看来会推动进一步减税，以重振经济。他也会尝试废除你的医疗改革法案。如果你只是以微弱差距落败，或许还能在2016年尝试东山再起。

revisions.source:
Congratulations! You have won the 2012 election.

In spite of a hard-fought campaign from Barack Obama, you have won the Presidency. Nearly two centuries after the ill-fated campaign of Joseph Smith, you will become America's first Mormon president. Your next steps are to select a cabinet and prepare a rousing inauguration speech. On the political front, you may have the support needed to overturn Obamacare. Or you could focus on tax cuts, or other policies entirely.
revisions.zh:
恭喜！你赢得了2012年大选。

尽管巴拉克·奥巴马奋力竞选，你还是赢得了总统职位。距离约瑟夫·斯密那场命运多舛的竞选近两个世纪之后，你将成为美国首位摩门教徒总统。接下来，你要挑选内阁成员，并准备一篇振奋人心的就职演说。在政策方面，你或许已有足够支持来推翻奥巴马医改；也可以把重点放在减税，或者其他完全不同的政策上。

revisions.source: Do you have any criticism of the authorities in Illinois, regarding their failure to properly protect Joseph Smith before his assassination in June?
revisions.zh: 约瑟夫·斯密在6月遭到暗杀前，伊利诺伊州当局未能妥善保护他。对此，你有什么批评？

revisions.source:
"Young man, there's no need to feel down."

YMCA screeched out from the TV screen as Donald J. Trump walked on stage.

Biden looked down, tears in eyes... he lost everything. He had failed the Democratic party, who would surely catapult him, and anyone involved in this loss, millions of miles away from them. He had failed Barack, who had put so much trust in him as to intervene on his behalf in the primaries. Not only had he failed the millions who had trusted him in the primaries, but he had failed his family. From now on, "Biden" would be a dirty phrase, his kids wouldn't be able to get anywhere without being associated with him. He would be a burden to everyone.

"It's fun to stay at the Y.M.C.A."

Biden picked up the pistol he kept in his drawer. Maybe McGovern could tell him how to deal with a loss like this.
revisions.zh:
“年轻人，不必垂头丧气。”

唐纳德·J.·特朗普走上舞台时，电视里尖声响起了YMCA。

拜登低下头，眼里含着泪……他失去了一切。他辜负了民主党，党内一定恨不得把他和所有参与这场败选的人都甩到天边。他辜负了巴拉克——巴拉克那么信任他，甚至在初选中出面为他助阵。他不仅辜负了初选时信任他的数百万选民，也辜负了自己的家人。从今往后，“拜登”会成为一个令人厌恶的名字；孩子们无论走到哪里，都会被人想到与他的关系。他将成为所有人的负担。

“在Y.M.C.A.，大家过得多么快乐。”

拜登拿起了放在抽屉里的手枪。也许麦戈文能告诉他，该如何面对这样的失败。
